appIcon.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: production PWA app icon, square full-bleed bitmap
Primary request: Create a premium original XAU REPLAY app icon for a gold trading replay and backtesting app. No text.
Scene/backdrop: solid deep near-black navy #0b1119 edge to edge; no outer rounded-square container, no border.
Subject: one simple geometric warm-gold emblem combining a counterclockwise replay arc ending in a clear right-facing play triangle with three compact vertical candlestick bars. Keep the emblem bold and visually quiet, use only these essential elements.
Style/medium: precise flat vector-like brand design with beautifully crisp edges, restrained subtle metallic gold tonal variation and soft premium lighting. It must read clearly as a financial replay app at 32 pixels.
Composition/framing: square 1:1, emblem centered, roughly 55–60 percent of canvas width, generous 20 percent safe padding on all sides for maskable mobile app icons.
Color palette: deep navy #0b1119, warm satin gold #d7b36a, understated brighter highlights.
Constraints: no text, no lettering, no mockup, no device, no visible frame, no decorative charts, no watermark, no excessive glow, no detailed textures. Make a polished final icon as a flat image, not a photograph.

logo.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: transparent horizontal brand logo for a premium gold-market replay and backtesting web application
Primary request: Create a polished transparent brand logo based on the reference app icon. Keep the emblem's identity: a counterclockwise gold replay arrow around three gold candlesticks and a right-facing play triangle. Arrange a compact clean version of this emblem on the left, and a beautifully spaced uppercase modern sans-serif wordmark on the right.
Input images: Image 1 is a reference for the same brand emblem and palette, not a background to preserve.
Text (verbatim): "XAU REPLAY". Spell exactly X A U space R E P L A Y. Single line. No other text.
Color palette: restrained warm satin gold #d7b36a for both emblem and typography; suitable for a dark navy application header.
Style/medium: crisp precision vector-like brand artwork, subtle premium gold tonal variation only on the emblem, wordmark legible and almost flat. No mockup or photograph.
Composition/framing: horizontal 3:1 composition, balanced emblem-to-wordmark scale, centered with generous transparent space, slim but readable modern geometric sans serif typography, subtle letter spacing.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with alpha channel, no dark rectangular background, no border, no watermarks, no tagline, no extraneous text, no glow. Consistent visual identity with the app icon.

derivativeMode: Sharp 0.35.4: resizing and PNG compression only; emblem and wordmark unchanged
